description: This Java source file defines the LocalHTTPDManager class, which manages the lifecycle of a LocalHTTPD server using a HandlerThread, including starting, stopping, and restarting the server, and broadcasting status events.

classes.name: LocalHTTPDManager
classes.description: Manages the lifecycle of a LocalHTTPD server using a HandlerThread, including starting, stopping, and restarting, with broadcast notifications.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the LocalHTTPD server with default HTTPS setting from preferences.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Starts the LocalHTTPD server with specified HTTPS usage; initializes HandlerThread and Handler, manages server startup and error handling.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the LocalHTTPD server if running and broadcasts stop event.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Restarts the server with default HTTPS setting from preferences.

methods.name: restart
methods.description: Restarts the server with specified HTTPS usage; stops current server, waits for shutdown, then starts anew.

methods.name: isAlive
methods.description: Checks if the HandlerThread managing the server is currently alive.
